description: VoxSentinel ROHAN-002 spoof-detection evaluation set: 40 genuine and 40 synthetic samples. Audio is NOT committed. Rebuild it with ml/scripts/prepare_eval_set.py, which regenerates every sample from this manifest and verifies each SHA-256.
genuine_selection_rule: Sort every *.flac under dev-clean by POSIX path. Walking that order, take the first utterance per speaker whose duration is >= 4.5s. Stop at 40 speakers. One utterance per speaker.
synthetic_generation_note: Piper's default noise_scale and noise_w_scale sample inside the ONNX graph, so the same text yields different audio on every run. Both are pinned to 0.0 here, which makes synthesis bit-reproducible. Seeding numpy does NOT help.
